description: Use this when the person asks where or when to surf around a place. when is in the person's words (tomorrow morning, Saturday, this weekend); default the next 24 hours. Not for one spot's full hours: use get_surf_forecast. Answers surf spots near the place, ranked for the time asked (today, tomorrow, tomorrow morning, this weekend, a date): each spot's best window in that time with its wave height, period, wind and why it ranks there, and the spots with nothing good in that time last; within radius_km (default 30, at most 100).

near.description: a town, a coast or a spot: Lisbon, Hossegor, Supertubos

when.description: in people's words: today, tomorrow morning, this weekend, Saturday, 2026-11-28

name: find_best_surf
